text:
maria: Hi team — opened a PR to bump OpenSSL in the baseimage to 1.1.1k to pick up the recent security fix. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/baseimages/pull/432. CI/builds are green locally and on the PR builder. Can someone take a quick look+approve? This touches Dedicated and Private images, so planning to merge during a low-traffic window.

tj: I'm on it. Quick question — did you run the legacy client compatibility tests (s3 signing, jwt flows)?

maria: yep ran the compat suite and an e2e matrix (ubuntu20/22, debian11). No failures. I left the test matrix and raw build log link in the PR description. Also bumped the image tag in Dockerfile.

security-bot: Note: NVD recommends 1.1.1k for CVE-2024-XXXX and related issues. Scan result attached to the PR.

amir: LGTM overall. Small nit: please remove the ENV SSL_CERT_DIR override — it breaks cert chaining in our runtime. Add a changelog entry under /changelogs/ops while you're at it.

tj: Also add a rollback plan snippet in the PR description (how to pin old image + terraform steps) so SRE can revert quickly if needed.

maria: will update PR with both changes now.

tj: ping me when updated and I'll re-check.

amir: once the ENV bit is removed, I'll approve.

maria: updated — removed ENV override, added changelog and rollback steps (see bottom of PR). PTAL @tj @amir.

tj: 👍 approving now.

amir: approved.

deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed. Canary pushed to us-west-2, health checks = OK :white_check_mark:.

maria: thanks everyone. planning merge at 18:00 PT today to avoid morning traffic. Will monitor canary and open a rollback runbook if anything pops. :rocket:

security-bot: Reminder: file an internal security notice for affected customers after merge.

maria: will do and cc security. Thanks!
